first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: gray head-and-chest bust
entities.identification: A dark gray hairless head-and-chest bust placed on the white two-tier rotating platform, with a long neck and a shoulder cross-section.

entities.name: white two-tier rotating platform
entities.identification: The broad, low-profile white circular base supporting the bust, with upper and lower tiers, a dark gap between the tiers, and a dark circular area on the front.

entities.name: white rectangular backdrop panel
entities.identification: The large bright white backdrop panel behind the bust and rotating platform.

entities.name: dark gray studio wall
entities.identification: The dark gray background wall outside the white backdrop panel, with slight variations in tone.

entities.name: black foreground camera
entities.identification: The black camera in the lower-left foreground with its back facing the viewing viewpoint, featuring a lens, flip-out screen, viewfinder, and rear buttons.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Person A, whose hand operates the black foreground camera; after the shot cut at frame 21, only the hand and dark cuff are visible at the left edge, continuously corresponding to the hand reaching toward the camera in frames 0 through 7 of cp002.

entities.name: light-colored textured tabletop
entities.identification: The light gray-white horizontal tabletop supporting the rotating platform, with blurry gray bands and patches of varying lightness visible on the exposed portion.

entities.name: bar-shaped light fixture at the top
entities.identification: The slender dark light fixture extending horizontally at an angle above the bust in frame 21, with a light-colored support arm attached to its right end and extending toward the upper right.

entities.name: black light stand on the right
entities.identification: The vertical dark rod-like stand at the image-right edge of the white backdrop panel in frame 21, with clamps and protruding joints.

entities.name: “REMOTE CONTROL” subtitle graphic
entities.identification: The large black bold uppercase English subtitle in the lower part of the image, slightly right of center, surrounded by a thin red outline with a break in the middle of its bottom edge.
